name: Nuclear Decommissioning Benchmark
description: 7-condition benchmark for paper: single-pass vs. multi-pass vs. multi-pass+law, 3 model sizes (gemma4:e2b, gemma4:e4b, gemma4:31b), nemotron ablation, plus max-capacity gemma4:31b (10 iterations + law). 3 runs each for statistical reliability.
description_de: 7-Bedingungen-Benchmark fuer das Paper: Single-Pass vs. Multi-Pass vs. Multi-Pass+Law, 3 Modellgroessen (gemma4:e2b, gemma4:e4b, Nemotron-Ablation). Je 3 Laeufe fuer statistische Belastbarkeit.
